newsitem.title: FRANCE: French EDF utility profit rises in 1996, debt dips.
newsitem.headline: French EDF utility profit rises in 1996, debt dips.

text.p: French state utility Electricite de France (EDF) said on Thursday it made an overall profit of 5.9 billion francs last year, versus 2.7 billion previously.
After a payment of four billion francs to the government, it retained a 1.9 billion surplus, against 1.2 billion in 1995, an EDF statement said. It paid the state 1.5 billion in 1995.
Turnover rose 1.4 percent to 191.1 billion francs, after 188.6 billion in 1995, thanks to increased sales volumes and despite tariff cuts.
It cut debt to 132.9 billion francs from 145.5 billion.
Investment totalled 36.1 billion francs and was amply covered by cashflow of 52 billion, it said.
The EDF will see the domestic electricity market opened up to competition under terms set by the European Commission this year.

"In the coming years, beyond the investment required for its main activities and to develop in France and internationally, the EDF will need to acquire financial assets to cover future charges..." it said.
